changes.title: Tree normals switch
items: A test switch on the pause page turns the trees' normal maps off, so the trees are lit flat, to judge whether they still look right without them. Normal maps stay on by default.

changes.title: Station rework
items: Every treehouse station menu now fits on the screen: no more scrolling
New basin by the bed: skin tone, makeup (lipstick, eyeshadow, blush) and a button to brush your teeth
Each station holds fewer things: hair, sunglasses and earrings at the dressing table; jacket and top on the wardrobe rail; trousers and shoes at the shoe rack
Bags show as small cards; the one you're on shows how it throws, with its firing preview
Smaller colour swatches, and what you're wearing is clearly marked, even on pale colours
Things you haven't found yet show as grey shapes, no padlocks
Menus open on what you're wearing, and the camera frames the part of you each station changes
Guest bedrooms get their own basin and shoe rack
The DJ booth matches the other menus, and its prompt hides while it's open
Your first morning starts at the basin, then the dressing table
A new witch starts with light green skin

changes.title: Skin tones
items: The dressing table's skin colours are now a full range of human skin tones (the Monk Skin Tone Scale), palest to deepest, plus five witchy tones: frost blue, lilac, ash grey, moss green and night indigo
Random witches and Randomise now pick from the full range of human skin tones
A new witch's starting skin is now the nearest tone on the new range
The skin colour you choose now stays the same after reloading the game

changes.title: Pattern spin
items: The coloured spokes of light round the playing soundsystems now visibly turn, once every 2 bars and faster as the tempo rises, on up to three nearby stumps instead of only the nearest

changes.title: Berry spread
items: Twice as many berry patches in every area
Berry patches are spread evenly through each area's woods instead of bunching together
Berry bushes and mushrooms no longer grow in a stump's fighting ground: they keep about 55 m from every stump
Mushrooms no longer grow beside berry bushes or on paths, unless there's nowhere else in the area
